tags_implications.title: Tag Implications
tags_implications.description: Tag implications allow you to define relationships between tags. When a target tag is applied to a media item, the implied tags will be automatically applied as well. If there is more than one target tag (or pattern), then the implied tags will only be added if all targets are matched. Wildcards (* and ?) are supported in target tags.

tags_implications.apply_all_processing: Applying tag implications to all media...
